Game Overview

Sustainable puts players into a fighting experience centered on dive into the chaos of museum defense as you hunt eco-terrorists intent on vandalizing art. Patrol galleries, identify suspects, and wield your trusty tonfa to stop them. Unravel the mystery during tense interrogations, racing against time to protect priceless masterpieces. Can you catch the culprit and save the art?
